context.utterance: A sandwich can contain bread, tomato, ham.

node.label: Tomato
node.summary: Tomato adds a juicy vegetable layer to the sandwich.

output.summary: Tomato is a juicy slice that can be one of the fillings in the sandwich.

sections.whatItIs: A tomato is the fleshy fruit of the tomato plant. It is mostly water, with a thin skin around soft flesh and seeds.
sections.whyItMattersHere: Your sentence says a sandwich can contain tomato, so the tomato is an optional layer: the sandwich is still a sandwich without it.
sections.howItWorks: Sliced tomato adds moisture and a slightly sour taste that contrasts with the bread and ham.
sections.commonMisconception: Cooks treat tomato as a vegetable, but botanically it is a fruit because it develops from the flower and holds seeds.

context.utterance: The sun rises in the east.

node.label: Rises
node.summary: Rising is the Sun's apparent upward movement above the horizon.

notes.text: The Sun only appears to rise because Earth rotates from west to east.

output.summary: The Sun looks like it rises in the east because Earth is spinning.

sections.whatItIs: Rising is when the Sun first peeks over the edge of the land or sea in the morning.
sections.whyItMattersHere: Your sentence says the sun rises in the east. The arrow shows where you see it appear each morning.
sections.howItWorks: Earth spins like a top. Each morning your side of Earth turns towards the Sun. The Sun comes into view in the east.
sections.commonMisconception: The Sun does not really climb up. Earth spins, so the Sun only looks like it rises.
